title: Sample: Arnesh Kumar v. State of Bihar
text: The power to arrest must be exercised with care and caution. Arrest brings humiliation and curtails freedom. The police officer must justify the arrest.

title: Sample: Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973, Section 438
text: When any person has reason to believe that he may be arrested on an accusation of having committed a non-bailable offence, he may apply for a direction that he shall be released on bail in the event of arrest.

title: Sample: Siddharam Satlingappa Mhetre v. State of Maharashtra
text: Anticipatory bail in economic offences needs the court to weigh the gravity of the offence and the stage of investigation before granting protection from arrest.

title: Sample: limitation for filing a civil suit
text: A civil suit must be filed within the period of limitation prescribed by the Limitation Act. Delay can be condoned only on sufficient cause being shown.
